data.one_liner: Provides PNG and SVG country flag assets for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles a large collection of country flag icons in PNG and SVG formats. It exposes them as assets that can be loaded with Image.asset or SvgPicture.asset, and also offers a helper method to retrieve SVG flags by country code.
use_when: You need a ready‑made set of country flags without network requests
You want simple, offline assets for UI elements like dropdowns or lists
avoid_when: You require flags that are not included in the collection
You need runtime updates or custom styling beyond the provided SVGs
strengths: Easy to use with standard Flutter asset loading
weaknesses: Adds a sizable amount of assets to the app bundle
Limited to the flags provided in the package
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; include flutter_svg if you use SVG flags.

alternatives.name: country_flags
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another flag‑icon package with a similar asset‑based approach
